headline: Maersk probes IT security incident and data theft; OpenSSH SSHole due 11-12; Barracuda ESG due 11-13; Cisco BroadWorks exploited

bullets.text: New: shipping giant Maersk is investigating an IT security incident involving data theft. eMudhra has revoked 8 more CAs it had previously declared unaffected by its key compromise.

Healthcare and education: a Korean hospital's care was disrupted by ransomware (MBC), Ridgecrest Regional Hospital in California took systems offline, Vanderbilt is on lockdown after a ransomware attack (6 outlets), and two US school districts shut systems.
Due tomorrow, 11-12: OpenSSH SSHole CVE-2026-123158 (exploited to breach Linux systems, 4 outlets), GPUStack CVE-2026-102895, FreeSwitch CVE-2026-116779 and IBM Aspera Faspex CVE-2026-123218.
Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 (auth bypass) and CVE-2026-111560 (OS command injection) are exploited in attacks (4 outlets); KEV due 11-13. Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935 is also due 11-13.

Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 (XXE) and Openwave Webtop CVE-2026-111793 are exploited despite patches (KEV due 11-24). Microsoft patched exploited Outlook CVE-2026-124194 (NTLMv2 hash exposure) and Chrome zero-day CVE-2026-125350 is due 11-24.

Still active: N-able keeps hosted N-central offline after dozens of published zero-days; SAP patched four CVSS 10.0 flaws (ICM2SHELL); Xen Orchestra auth bypass is exploited; France blames Iran for sabotage at ~700 retail sites. The week ran 1.09x the 90-day average.

actions: Patch OpenSSH (CVE-2026-123158), GPUStack, FreeSwitch and IBM Aspera Faspex today; their KEV deadline is 11-12.
Barracuda ESG: apply fixes for CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 (due 11-13) and hunt for compromise; patch Ivanti Connect Secure too.
Check trust stores and certificate inventories for eMudhra-issued CAs and replace any certificates chaining to revoked CAs.
Patch Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave Webtop, roll out Microsoft's November updates (Outlook CVE-2026-124194 first), and update Chrome.
Apply SAP's patches for the four CVSS 10.0 flaws and patch or isolate Xen Orchestra servers.
Healthcare, education and logistics IT: review remote access and offline backups given this week's hospital, university and Maersk incidents.
